testCatalog.requirementName: Scenario C: Unauthorized Cross-Tenant Record Access

testCatalog.securityFindings: Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA): GET /api/orders allows any authenticated caller to read another company's purchase history.

bugLog.description: Broken Object-Level Authorization (BOLA) in GET /api/orders: Public or customer callers without email filter can view other companies orders.
bugLog.preconditions: Orders from multiple companies exist in database.
bugLog.expectedResult: Customer should only see their own orders, or receive 401/403 without admin credentials.
bugLog.actualResult: Returns all orders across all wholesale buyers.
bugLog.rootCause: server/index.js lines 644-657 filters by email only if req.query.email is explicitly passed by caller.
bugLog.recommendedFix: Bind filtering to authenticated user session: const user = getAuthUser(req); if (user?.role === "customer") filtered = filtered.filter(o => o.customer?.email === user.email);

bugLog.description: Customer A can view Customer B orders by querying /api/orders?email=target@company.com.
bugLog.preconditions: Orders exist for target customer account.
bugLog.actualResult: HTTP 200 OK returning Customer B private order and shipping address details.
bugLog.rootCause: server/index.js lines 644-657 filters solely by req.query.email without verifying if requester owns that email or has admin role.
bugLog.recommendedFix: Enforce tenant ownership: if (user.role === "customer") { email = user.email; }
